question: In the lithium-mediated ammonia review's comparison of electrolysers, which electrolyte does the gas diffusion electrode flow cell with 300 h stability use, and what faradaic and energy efficiencies does it reach?
expect: LiBF4 in C2H5OH/DG (diglyme); FE 64%, EE 17% (at −6 mA cm−2) (Table 1)
rendered: According to the document, the gas diffusion electrode flow cell with 300 h stability uses diglyme (DG) as the solvent, and LiBF4 as the electrolyte. It reaches a faradaic efficiency of 98% and an energy efficiency of 13 ± 1%.
